description: This file defines the interface for the shared channel service in Mattermost, including mock implementations and related methods.

classes.name: mockSharedChannelService
classes.description: Mock implementation of the SharedChannelServiceIFace interface, used for testing.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the shared channel service (mock implementation).

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the shared channel service (mock implementation).

methods.name: Active
methods.description: Returns whether the service is active.

methods.name: NotifyChannelChanged
methods.description: Notifies that a channel has changed.

methods.name: NotifyUserProfileChanged
methods.description: Notifies that a user profile has changed.

methods.name: SendChannelInvite
methods.description: Sends an invite to a channel.

methods.name: NumInvitations
methods.description: Returns the number of invitations sent.
